name: Undersurf Boat
piloting: Sailing Lore (DC 20), Diplomacy (DC 22), Intimidation (DC 22), or Nature (DC 22)

items.name: Submersible
items.text: This vehicle can travel below the surface of the water, usually to a depth of no deeper than 60 feet. Though enclosed, it is not watertight, so crew and passengers must hold their breath or be able to breathe underwater.

text: Resembling a large, oared kayak with closable hatches, the submersible surfboat was designed by azarketi shipwrights for use above and below the waves.
